claim.claim-text: 1. A method of determining the density of an elongate rod of material as it travels in a longitudinal direction through an inspection zone of apparatus for determining the density of an elongate rod of material, wherein the method comprises:
2. A method according to claim 1, comprising operating the X-ray generator at a voltage of 60kV.
3. A method according to claim 1 or claim 2, comprising supplying the X-ray generator with a current of 0.6mA.

4. Use of the method of any one of claims 1 to 3 to determine the density of an elongate rod of tobacco comprising homogenous, reconstituted, cut tobacco wrapped in a laminate of wrapping material and metal foil.
5. A method of manufacturing tobacco industry products using a tobacco industry product manufacturing machine, the method comprising:
6. A method according to claim 5, wherein the method further comprises attaching a filter portion to each of said individual tobacco rod elements to form tobacco industry products.
7. Apparatus for determining the density of an elongate rod of material as it travels in a longitudinal direction through an inspection zone of said apparatus, comprising:

8. Apparatus for simultaneously determining the density of each of two elongate rods of material travelling side-by-side in a longitudinal direction, the apparatus comprising an X-ray generator positioned to transmit X-rays of a predetermined intensity in a direction across the both elongate rods, a voltage source to supply a voltage to the X-ray generator of between 20 to 80kV to transmit the X-rays at a predetermined intensity and to supply a current to the X-ray generator of between 0.3-1mA, a respective detector associated with each elongate rod, and a signal processor, each of said respective detectors being configured to independently detect the intensity of X-rays transmitted through an associated elongate rod and to send a signal indicative of said detection to said signal processor, the signal processor being configured to compare said detected intensity as determined by a respective detector with the predetermined intensity to determine the density of each rod.

9. Apparatus according to claim 8, comprising a reference detector for detecting the intensity of X-rays generated by the X-ray generator, the reference detector being positioned to detect X-rays that have not been transmitted through the elongate rods of material travelling side-by-side in a longitudinal direction.
10. A method of determining the density of each of two elongate rods of material as they travel side-by-side in a longitudinal direction, wherein the method includes:
11. A method according to claim 10, comprising operating the X-ray generator at a voltage of 60kV.
12. A method according to claim 10 or claim 11, comprising supplying the X-ray generator with a current of 0.6mA.

13. Use of the method of any of claims 10 to 12 to determine the density of an elongate rod of tobacco comprising homogenous, reconstituted cut tobacco wrapped in a laminate of wrapping material and metal foil.
14. A tobacco industry product manufacturing machine comprising apparatus according to claim 8 or 9.
15. A method of manufacturing tobacco industry products using a tobacco industry product manufacturing machine, the method comprising:
16. A method according to claim 15, comprising attaching a filter portion to each of said individual tobacco rod elements to form tobacco industry products.
